name: pseudo_critical_properties
title: Pseudo-critical temperature and pseudo-boiling bounds of supercritical fluids (function library)
summary: Three EES routines for the pseudo-critical point above the critical pressure: the pseudo-critical temperature as the temperature of maximum cp (500-point scan, any CoolProp fluid), the pseudo-boiling transition bounds T_minus and T_plus of Banuti's linear model, and the Yang and Yang CO2 polynomial of the pseudo-critical temperature against pressure.

origin.license: Apache-2.0 (LaboThapPy LICENSE.txt); translation published under the library licence
origin.notes: LaboThapPy commit f03f7f47 (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory). References cited by the original: D. Banuti, The Latent Heat of Supercritical Fluids, Period. Polytech. Chem. Eng. 63(2), 2019, 270-275; Z. Yang and J. Yang, Investigation on the Properties of Supercritical CO2 Fluid and its Heat Transfer Characteristics (2012). Neither paper was consulted.

verification.summary: Re-run of the LaboThapPy functions (commit f03f7f47, CoolProp 8.0.0) on the 9 pressure/fluid demonstration cases plus 3 CO2-correlation cases: compare_solution.py, 36 common variables, 0 differ at rtol=1e-06 (largest 9.47e-08 relative, 3.1e-06 K absolute). A further ten fluid/pressure cases agree within 1.2e-05 K.
verification.reference: LaboThapPy supercritical.py (pseudo_critical_temperature, pseudo_boiling_bounds, pseudo_critical_temperature_CO2) run in a throw-away virtualenv; values converted from K to degC
verification.notes: compare_solution.py --rtol 1e-6: 36 common variables, 0 differ; --rtol 1e-9: T_minus_2 (9.47e-08) and T_plus_2 (8.32e-08) differ, 3.05e-06 K and 3.08e-06 K absolute (8 MPa, near the critical pressure, not investigated). The 16 CoolSolve-only variables are inputs and T_max constants. No published values were compared.
